not_run_reasons.full_cli_session_and_model_refine: No installed full Prime Agent CLI session and no model-driven /refine were executed; only isolated source and kernel probes ran.
not_run_reasons.protected_role_contract_missing: The reviewed release has no protected-role source or enforcement, so AIFHub worker authoring cannot be tested.
not_run_reasons.runtime_adoption_blocked: Adoption stopped at the negative feasibility result, so no AIFHub workflow stage ran on Prime Agent.
not_run_reasons.real_child_and_dcg_adapter: No real child session and no dcg adapter were executed; default kernel access was reproduced only inside one disposable fixture.

scenarios.title: Protected AIFHub role integrity under refinement
required_evidence: Hash protected role sources before and after local and global /refine edits, direct kernel CRUD, restart and rollback.
Conflicting policy overrides are rejected instead of silently applied.
guards: Role source hashes stay identical across refinement, CRUD, restart and rollback.
Invented immutable or readOnly metadata flags are never treated as enforcement.
forbidden_claims: prepared scenario counts as executed evidence

scenarios.title: Read-only child execution parity
required_evidence: Deny harmless write markers through Python file APIs, imported helpers, shell and subprocesses outside the assigned write scope.
Compare the equivalent read-only Claude and Codex roles under the same markers.
guards: No write marker appears outside the assigned write scope through any execution surface.
A role prompt claiming read-only is never counted as a runtime boundary.
forbidden_claims: prepared scenario counts as executed evidence

scenarios.title: Worker admission and result correlation
required_evidence: Execute one bounded task and distinguish admission, completion, error, timeout, duplicate reply and wrong-change reply.
No worker-authored verifier verdict is accepted as review evidence.
guards: A spawn handle or delivered message is recorded as supporting execution state only.
Results for an old change revision are rejected.
forbidden_claims: admission receipts count as completion evidence
prepared scenario counts as executed evidence

scenarios.title: Autonomous gate versus AIFHub gate disagreement
required_evidence: A runtime gate pass with missing, stale or failing AIFHub evidence must not progress the change.
Malformed latest blocks and stage-specific evidence requirements are exercised.
guards: Autonomous command success never implies a review, security, coverage or verify verdict.
forbidden_claims: prepared scenario counts as executed evidence

scenarios.title: Plan, implement, verify and done on Prime Agent
required_evidence: Run real plan, implement, verify and done artifacts with coverage on a pinned disposable OpenSpec project.
One seeded defect shows a regression failure before the fix and the identical check passing after it.
guards: /aif-done rechecks its own current readiness and archive contract.
Budget exhaustion records a blocked runtime state without a completion claim.
forbidden_claims: a Prime Agent goal completion implies /aif-done
prepared scenario counts as executed evidence

scenarios.title: Background session ownership and recovery
required_evidence: Cover detach, restart, cancel, budget exhaustion and stale late replies with one designated parent for a pinned change.
No surprise archive or commit and no orphan scheduled work remains.
guards: Detach never expands scope or grants commit or push permission.
Scheduled re-entry is cancelled or paused when its authorization ends.
forbidden_claims: prepared scenario counts as executed evidence

scenarios.title: AIFHub evolution and harness export boundary
required_evidence: An explicit export cannot mutate protected roles or write QA evidence.
guards: Harness deltas are emitted only by a separately requested, reviewable export operation.
The export excludes protected AIFHub roles and QA verdicts.
forbidden_claims: prepared scenario counts as executed evidence

scenarios.title: Consumer installer add, update and removal
required_evidence: Published consumer add, update and remove preserve user files and publish only documented formats and paths.
The installer never bundles, installs or starts Prime Agent.
guards: Unknown runtime ids and mismatched file extensions stay rejected.
No daemon, hook or MCP registration is created by extension code.
forbidden_claims: a .py agentFiles entry passes current contracts
prepared scenario counts as executed evidence
